end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Used examples including a rocket cone, candle cylinder, ball sphere and ice-cream cone.
Discussed circular flat faces on a cylinder and round surfaces on a sphere.
Aditya repeatedly said a cone changes its name when turned; this was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised shapes through familiar objects and questions about flat and curved surfaces. Aditya named the rocket tip as a cone, the candle as a cylinder, and balls as spheres. They mixed up the idea that turning a cone changes its shape name, and this remained at the end. At home, rotate a party hat or cone and ask, “Is it still a cone when it is turned?”
